_usage: Main result list: the contributor goes to arlas.web.contributors, the component to arlas.web.components.resultlists (never a copy in analytics). input.id = contributorId, searchSize = search_size, idFieldName = params.id_path of the collection. hasListView needs at least one column; hasCardView needs cardViewProperties; hasGridView needs urlThumbnailTemplate and titleFieldNames[0]. Readable values (Règle G5) with `process` (< 250 characters, on `result`): duration in seconds → "Math.floor(result/3600)+' h '+Math.round((result%3600)/60)+' min'"; metres → kilometres "Math.round(result/100)/10+' km'"; one decimal "Math.round(result*10)/10"; a DATE field always needs a process, from its mapping format: epoch_second → "new Date(result*1000).toISOString().slice(0,16).replace('T',' ')", epoch_millis or ISO → "new Date(result).toISOString().slice(0,16).replace('T',' ')", and "(UTC)" in the column name (DATE-1). A column name says what it shows without ambiguity: "Date de départ", not "Départ" when a place of departure also exists. Group the details in sections by role (entity, document measures, places or secondary geometries, time).
